subject: Tiered commit proposal and checkpoint approvals for Orbit AI evaluation
messages:
From: Tamsin Carter <tamsin@orbitai.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-22T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: evaluation MAP + pricing checkpoints

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the KV-cache examples. We want to formalize a short MAP so our Security and Procurement teams can move the evaluation forward. High level ask: a 6-week evaluation with three checkpoints tied to increasing commit levels (pilot -> POC -> production ramp). At each checkpoint we need:

- Clear acceptance criteria (latency, throughput, cost per 1k tokens)
- A commercial checkpoint with proposed commit and discount triggers
- Proof points for data handling and SOC2 artifacts

Could you share a tiered commit proposal and a simple MAP document we can circulate internally? Also flag any approvals you'd need on your end for upfront credits or checkpoint discounts.

We're targeting an Exec review the week of Apr 5.

Thanks,
Tamsin
Tamsin Carter
Head of Platform Partnerships, Orbit AI
T: +1 415-555-0123

_Attachment referenced: Orbit’s internal evaluation timeline (not attached)_,

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Tamsin Carter <tamsin@orbitai.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: evaluation MAP + pricing checkpoints

Hi Tamsin — great to hear the demo landed. Attached is a draft MAP (orbit-map-v2.pdf) and a spreadsheet with a tiered commit pricing model (tiered-commit-pricing.xlsx). Summary below: 

MAP summary (6 weeks)
- Week 1-2 (Pilot): 0-50k tokens/day; acceptance: inference latency P95 < 250ms; cost allowance: hosted API at list rates. No commit.
- Week 3-4 (POC): 50-250k tokens/day; acceptance: throughput sustained at target, 10% model quality parity on eval set. Proposed commit: $25k/month reserved for 3 months -> 10% discount on unit price.
- Week 5-6 (Ramp): 250k+ tokens/day; acceptance: ops readiness, monitoring hooks; proposed commit: $75k/month reserved -> 18% discount plus 30% credit off first-month overage.

Checkpoint approvals: each checkpoint requires a brief sign-off from Orbit platform lead and Redwood sales manager to unlock the next discount tranche. For the discount above 15% we need authorization from commercial leadership.

I've indicated two items that need internal approvals on our side: an initial $10k evaluation credit and ability to provide a 30% first-month overage credit for Ramp-phase customers (both to be approved by sales leadership). Laura, can you review and confirm we have flexibility on the evaluation credit and the one-time overage concession?

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

Attachments: orbit-map-v2.pdf, tiered-commit-pricing.xlsx

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-23T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Kickoff: evaluation MAP + pricing checkpoints — approval request

Markus / Laura — quick internal note after reviewing the MAP and pricing spreadsheet:

Concise recommendation: we can approve the $10k evaluation credit and the 10% POC discount as standard.

Open items that need Sales Ops / Sales Leadership OK:
- 18% discount for Ramp + 30% first-month overage credit = requires commercial leadership approval (this is >15% and includes a one-time credit).
- Contract term for Ramp commit: need to confirm minimum 3-month commit or auto-renew behavior.

Suggested next steps before we share the final MAP with Orbit:
1) Get Laura's signoff on whether Commercial Leadership will entertain the 18% + 30% first-month credit as a standard concession for strategic POCs.
2) If yes, we prepare a short exception memo (1 paragraph) for record and include the concession in the DocuSign.
3) Draft a one-page summary for Orbit execs highlighting risk mitigations and rollback policy if acceptance criteria aren't met.

If we want to keep it simple for their Exec review Apr 5, I'd propose we send the MAP marking the Ramp concession as "pending commercial approval" with an explicit approval timeline of Apr 2. That keeps momentum.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Strategic Sales Operations — Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-25T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Kickoff: evaluation MAP + pricing checkpoints — approval request

Thanks team — after speaking with Commercial leadership:

Decision:
- Approve $10k evaluation credit (standalone).
- Approve 10% POC discount as table stakes.
- Approve Ramp concession package (18% discount + 30% first-month overage credit) as an exception for Orbit AI contingent on:
   * Signed MAP and a minimum 3-month Ramp commit (DocuSign clause).
   * Legal to insert a rollback clause: if acceptance criteria not met at checkpoint, customer may pause Ramp and revert to POC pricing for 30 days.
   * Deal flagged in HubSpot and an audit log entry created for the financial concession.

Action items (assigned):
- Markus: send updated MAP and pricing with "Ramp concession — pending signoff" language removed, include exception memo and DocuSign link. Target: 2027-03-26 EOD.
- Marissa: prepare the one-page executive summary for their Apr 5 review.
- Legal: we will loop in Legal to draft the rollback clause (I'll open the ticket).

I'll mark this as approved in the deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8743

Laura Bennett
VP, Commercial Operations — Redwood Inference
